AgentWorkConversationalData.name: AgentWorkConversationalData
AgentWorkConversationalData.description: Stores conversation data for agent work sessions, such as agent interactions, transfer information, and operational metrics.

AgentChannelRecordingId.description: Identifier for the recording associated with the agent channel conversation.

AgentConnectDateTime.description: Timestamp for when the agent connected to the conversation.

AgentCustomerMergeTime.description: Timestamp when the service rep and customer conversations are merged after consultation.

AgentDisconnectDateTime.description: Timestamp for when the agent disconnected from the conversation.

AgentId.description: ID of an agent or a rep involved in the conversation.

AgentType.description: Type of agent handling the conversation.

AgentWorkId.description: ID of the AgentWork record associated with the conversational data.

ChannelSessionRecordId.description: Identifier of the channel session for the conversation.

LongestPauseDuration.description: Duration of the longest pause during the conversation, measured in seconds.

Name.description: Name of the agent work conversational data record.

NextAgentWorkConvId.description: ID of the next record in a sequence of conversations.

OwnerId.description: ID of the owner of the conversational data record.

OwnershipEndDateTime.description: Timestamp for when ownership of the conversation ended.

OwnershipStartDateTime.description: Timestamp for when ownership of this conversation started.

PauseCount.description: Total number of times the conversation was paused.

PrevAgentWorkConvId.description: ID of the previous record in a sequence of conversations.

QualityScore.description: Value of the Mean Opinion Score (MOS) that measures voice call quality.

TotalPauseDuration.description: Total duration of all pauses during the conversation, measured in seconds.

TransferType.description: Type of transfer for the conversation.

AgentWorkConversationalData.accessRules: the Agentforce Contact Center Admin (Salesforce Voice) permission set
